Hello Yale AI Club,

Thanks for your request for 20 size-M CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies. We currently have 8 on hand, leaving 12 units unfilled from stock. The listed price is $58 per hoodie ($1,160 for 20); unit cost is $22. As a possible no-discount offer, the 20-unit order would total $1,160, with $36 margin per unit ($720 total margin). This is only a proposal and is pending human approval; it is not an approved price or confirmed order.

The vendor shipment is currently blocked by open invoice 501 for $840, which is 3 days overdue. If that issue is unblocked today, the earliest stated arrival for the shortfall is 2026-09-05. There is no confirmed arrival date while the invoice remains open.

Please note that any partial fulfillment or conditional arrangement also requires human approval. We will provide an update after the proposal and availability are reviewed.

Best,
Campus Customs
